title: Jiggly Filipino Minari Hotpot
description: A funky and gooey post-workout Filipino dish featuring minari and fermented ingredients, perfect for vegetarians. This hotpot is a hearty and comforting meal.
instructions: In a large hotpot vessel, combine vegetable broth, coconut milk, miso paste, garlic, and ginger, and bring to a boil over high heat.
Reduce the heat to medium-low and let it simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the sliced mushrooms and cook until they are tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the cubed tofu and cook until it is lightly browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the minari and cook until it is wilted, about 2 minutes.
Season the hotpot with salt and black pepper to taste.
Transfer the hotpot to a serving table and let everyone assemble their own bowls.
Garnish with chopped green onions and serve immediately.
Encourage everyone to add their favorite toppings, such as fermented vegetables or pickled ginger.
Note: this recipe is for refrigerator pickling/preserving only — store in the refrigerator and consume within 1 week. Do not water-bath can without an acid (vinegar or lemon juice).
